item.title: Proof of Work #1: The walks held. The table work did not.
item.author: Coastal Agentics
item.description: This week we ran walking and hand tests in MuJoCo. Pretrained walking policies on Unitree's G1, H1, and H1-2 stayed up on flat ground and recovered from a shove. A two-finger gripper stacked a three-block tower in seven of ten tries. A full G1 at a table, using a scripted arm and its own hand, stacked none of eight towers and poured none of five cups. Every clip on this page is a simulation.
